research_scope: Six new synthetic Scene families; production-shaped baseline proposal followed by at most one research-only repair proposal when the deterministic policy reports an issue.

deterministic_calibration_gate.scope_limit: The structured entrance check only covers registered SceneLayer.entrance values; it does not classify free-text path claims or certify semantic quality.

baseline.reason_for_two_wire_ceiling: The production Scene provider owns one bounded strict JSON/schema repair.

conditional_repair.trigger: A strict frozen baseline SceneTreeProposalV1 has at least one typed SceneClosedWorldIssueV1.

early_stop: Stop before live calls if any valid control is flagged or any registered mutation misses its target code.
Stop promotion if fewer than five strict repaired candidates are available.
Stop promotion on the first candidate-specific major regression from either reviewer.
Do not add samples or another repair wire after the frozen six-case block.
